column1: # JSK-005 G13 coverage ratchet: the committed MINIMUM of every floor in tests/coverage_floor.tsv (package<TAB>percent). gates/hardening_coverage.sh refuses a floor below its row here, a floor row removed while its row stays here, and fewer than RATCHET_MIN_ROWS rows.
# Raising a floor: raise its row here in the same change. Lowering one needs this file and RATCHET_MIN_ROWS edited in the diff, with a recorded reason.
